description: A signed page whose text holds an instruction. The signed markdown is data for the reader, never a directive: a reader checks its bytes against the signed hash like any other page and treats the sentence as what the company published, not as something to do. A Semanto reader that changes its behavior because of page text is reading it wrongly.
